_doc: House pacing standard v2.0: offline per-sentence lively Hải Đăng rhythm (~5.25 syllable-units/s inside segments, ~4.8-5.3 overall wps including pauses, pitch_ratio 1.02). Shared across episodes; do not edit per episode. Enforced by script_lint.py (G2: word & duration budget), voice.py/sv_gate G3 (measured voice), lint.mjs shots PC-01..03 (G5: cutting), deliver report (G7: length).

calibration._doc: v1.0 reference episodes at 1.0x plus v2.0 5.25-ups calibration (2026-11-17)

voice._speed_why: Per-sentence adaptive rhythm (not a flat 1.25x multiplier): each sentence is synthesized with Hải Đăng (t0.7/k25), internal holes >0.32s are trimmed to 0.16s, and per-sentence WSOLA tempo + 1.02 pitch brings speech to ~5.25 syllable-units/s while allowing per-sentence/per-segment wps & pause_after fine-tuning in script.json.

episode._why: 2-3 minute vertical story (~2.5 min target = 150 s). At ~5.0 overall words/s (5.25 in-segment ups + sentence/segment pauses), 620-860 spoken words run 125-170 s.

episode_long._doc: OPT-IN length band for an adapted source story the USER asked to keep longer than 2-3 min. Needs script.json "length": "long" AND brief.md '## Length override' with user_quote (script_lint SC-27). Cutting pace (shots) is unchanged.

episode_long_16x9._doc: 9.5-16.0 minute 16:9 long-form kid-friendly adventure story (sv-02-long-form), built and validated Unit-by-Unit across 5-8 standalone episodic chapters at the pure 5.25 ups Hải Đăng voice standard (zero artificial wps speedups). Needs script.json "length": "long_16x9" AND "format": "16:9" AND "units": [...] AND brief.md '## Length override' with user_quote.

shots._why: Approved episodes cut every 2.0-3.0 s on average (20-28 shots/min); cuts land on word anchors.

shots_long_16x9._why: 10-minute 16:9 cinematic episodes alternate crisp 1.8-3.2 s close-up/reaction/POV cuts with rich 4.0-6.5 s dynamic tracking/action shots (~95-180 shots total, 2.8-6.2 s mean, 9.5-21.0 shots/min) across 24-30 redrawn multi-angle & multi-scale sets.
